title: Gemini voice settings: consent card, choices and Stop (manual until automated)

clauses.text: The consent card puts No first, so Enter alone never agrees; only a person's choice of Yes on the page agrees.

steps.do: Open the consent card (press C) and press Enter without moving the choice.
steps.expect: No is chosen and nothing is agreed. Only choosing Yes (allow sending my microphone to Google while a session is open) and confirming it agrees.

clauses.text: It is off by default, and the switch and choices are saved and only administrators change them.

steps.do: As an administrator, turn the switch on and off and change one choice. Leave the page and come back.
steps.expect: The changes are kept. A person who is not an administrator is refused in words when trying to change them.

clauses.text: The page has who speaks (local or gemini), session length, quiet time, daily cap, spoken-reply cap, the start key's name, the wake hand-off, and a status row with the delay log and the limit meter.

steps.do: Walk down every row on the page and change one value in each choice, with the keys the page shows.
steps.expect: Each row shows its current value and each change is kept. The start key's name steps through names. The status row shows the delay log and the limit meter.

clauses.text: Keyboard and click do the same thing on every row.

steps.do: Change one choice with the keyboard, then one with the mouse.
steps.expect: Both change the value in the same way.

clauses.text: Stop now works for everyone, not only administrators.

steps.do: Sign in as a person who is not an administrator and press x (Stop now).
steps.expect: Stop now works: it closes the microphone and ends any open session.
